## Objective

Prevent false readiness at setup, selected startup, rerun and recovery boundaries.

## Scope

- Trusted static setup
- Neutral complete starters
- Authorized runtime probes
- Rerun and recovery preservation

## Entry conditions

- Corrected diagnostics and final-input dependency rules are available.

## Exit criteria

- Setup/runtime readiness gates and preserved-edition/recovery controls pass without implicit provisioning.

## Risks

- Preserve exact current inputs, project ownership and operation-specific authority; a failed required criterion blocks phase acceptance.

## TASK-019 - Verify static capability at setup boundaries

Integrate trusted static capability/readiness assessment into create, first preparation, manual Template-copy preparation and selected adoption/refresh result gates.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-005, REQ-007, REQ-008, REQ-011, REQ-022, REQ-023, REQ-024 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/init-new-project/scripts/init_new_project.py, SKILLS-depo/init-new-project/scripts/init_ontology_advanced.py, SKILLS-depo/init-new-project/assets/baseline-assets.json, SKILLS-depo/init-new-project/tests/test_ontology_setup.py, SKILLS-depo/init-new-project/tests/test_advanced_ontology_setup.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-002, TASK-003, TASK-018 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Static capability assessment must not become implicit execution of copied project code.

### Acceptance criteria

- Complete selected packages/tests/contracts, locks, identity and local bindings are checked before a valid starter assertion, using trusted static inspection without executing unknown copied code.
- Required failed checks expose the actual partial boundary and prevent successful-ready assertions; unselected runtime is explicitly not exercised.
- Earlier setup receipt editions retain their meaning and are never upgraded by an ordinary rerun.

### Planned verification

- Exercise complete, incomplete, customized and unavailable-capability setup fixtures.
- Verify copying success cannot hide failed required assessment and that no package/model/service is provisioned.

### Risks

- Reusable examples and starter paths must not carry current-root authority or knowledge.

### Acceptance criteria

- Template-derived projects specialize local identity/permitted binding, retain empty memory/neutral extensions and leave optional profiles disabled.
- Exact inventory controls exclude source records, projections, models, environments, certifications, bootstrap/session data and machine-specific fixture paths.
- Existing disabled/capture-off choices and customized assets are preserved by selected preparation.

### Planned verification

- Inspect neutral package inventories and generated destination identity/binding against the selected Template hashes.
- Run contamination and preservation controls without installations or model downloads.

### Risks

- A successful setup receipt cannot stand in for a runtime probe.

### Acceptance criteria

- Selected configuration, existing runtime/model/certification, guard bindings and required derived state are checked against final inputs before operational readiness.
- Stale/missing/timed-out/wrong-project/failed required components prevent readiness and retain precise failure/recovery information.
- Service/probe ownership, cleanup and operation authority remain explicit; ordinary health gains no install/start/repair behavior.

### Planned verification

- Run selected existing-runtime success/failure probes with deadlines and no implicit provisioning.
- Verify final required dependencies and owned service state before a readiness receipt is emitted.

## TASK-022 - Preserve rerun, edition and interrupted recovery semantics

Extend existing recovery/rerun coverage for repaired setup, adoption, maintenance and initiation without changing their authoritative receipt systems.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-017, REQ-024, REQ-025, REQ-026, REQ-027 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/init-new-project/tests/test_setup_recovery.py, SKILLS-depo/init-new-project/tests/test_advanced_ontology_recovery.py, SKILLS-depo/init-new-project/tests/test_advanced_ontology_adoption.py, SKILLS-depo/memory/tests/test_recovery.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/tests/test_guard_recovery.py |
| Dependencies | TASK-019, TASK-020, TASK-021 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- No hand repair, abandoned-lock assumption or replay of a different operation is permitted.

### Acceptance criteria

- Equivalent reruns do not duplicate registration/records, change choices or silently adopt newer editions.
- Interrupted operations resume only exact authorized selections with matching input/target/ownership preconditions; changed inputs and customized targets block replay.
- An old ready receipt loses current applicability when dependencies change, even if the original operation remains historically complete.

### Planned verification

- Inject interruption at meaningful existing transaction boundaries and rerun the same request.
- Exercise changed-source, conflicting-edit and unknown-owner controls; compare retained receipts and preserved state.
